name: account-deletion-readback
title: Account Deletion Readback
description: Before Delete, lists what goes, sole-owner teams (with transfer), App Store / Google Play plans that keep billing until cancelled there, the restore deadline, what is kept and a data export. Delete unlocks after a typed confirmation and can wait for the paid period to end.

meta.summary: Reads back everything an account deletion loses or keeps charging for, so users do not delete more than they expect or keep paying an app store.
meta.server: Authorise the deletion on the server, re-check ownership and active subscriptions there, and run any scheduled deletion and retention from the backend.
catches: Teams or workspaces where the user is the only owner, with a transfer action
App Store and Google Play subscriptions that keep billing after the account is gone
Deleting mid-way through a paid period, with an option to delete when it ends
No data export taken yet (the button reads "Delete without export")
A typed confirmation that does not match the phrase
limits: Only shows the items, teams and subscriptions you pass in; it does not discover them
Whether a store plan is cancelled comes from your data (e.g. the store's server API), not from the component
It does not perform deletion, export or transfer; those are your callbacks
a11y: Labelled confirmation input with aria-invalid and aria-describedby on a mismatch
Timing options are native radio inputs with labels
Export progress is announced in an aria-live="polite" region
The Delete button is described by the list of what still blocks it; focus moves to the first fix button
